meta.name: Stolen Girl
meta.description: In 1993, Maureen’s six-year-old daughter Amina is snuck out of the country by her ex-husband, Karim. After years of unsuccessful attempts to find her, Maureen intersects with a professional retriever of internationally abducted children who promises to help her find Amina in exchange for her collaboration.
meta.slogan: She'll cross every line just to hear her daughter's voice again.
